# appleads_ad (Resource)

Manages an Apple Ads ad — the assignment of a creative to an ad group.

Display campaigns (for example Today Tab via `APPSTORE_TODAY_TAB`) need both a creative and an ad to serve. Create `appleads_creative` first (typically `CUSTOM_PRODUCT_PAGE` wired to a product page id), then attach it here. Apple allows one active custom product page ad per ad group.

**Today Tab localization:** Custom product page app name and subtitle must be localized for the default language of each campaign country or region. Verify with `data.appleads_product_page_locales`.

**Immutable:** `ad_group_id`, `creative_id` — changing either returns an error (no `RequiresReplace`). Create a new `appleads_ad` to rotate creatives.

**Mutable:** `name`, `status` (`ENABLED` or `PAUSED`).

**Computed:** `id`, `campaign_id`, `creative_type`, `serving_status`, `serving_state_reasons`, `creation_time`, `modification_time`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manages an Apple Ads ad (creative assigned to an ad group).
# ad_group_id and creative_id are immutable — changing them returns an error
# instead of replacing the resource (which would discard ad identity/history).

resource "appleads_ad" "cpp" {
  ad_group_id = appleads_ad_group.today_tab.id
  name        = "CPP ad"
  creative_id = appleads_creative.cpp.id
  status      = "PAUSED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ad_group_id` (String) Parent ad group id (immutable). Changing this after create returns an error; create a new appleads_ad instead.
- `creative_id` (String) Creative id from `appleads_creative` (immutable). Changing this after create returns an error; create a new appleads_ad instead.
- `name` (String) Ad name unique within the ad group (mutable).
- `status` (String) User-controlled ad status: `ENABLED` or `PAUSED` (mutable).

### Read-Only

- `campaign_id` (String) Parent campaign id (resolved from the ad group).
- `creation_time` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creative_type` (String) Creative type reported by Apple (for example CUSTOM_PRODUCT_PAGE).
- `id` (String) Ad identifier (assignment of creative to ad group).
- `modification_time` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `serving_state_reasons` (List of String) Reasons the ad is not serving, when applicable.
- `serving_status` (String) Serving status indicator from Apple Ads.
